lines.intro: God made the whole world in six days! Help put each thing on the day God made it.
lines.round-1: Day Three: God made the dry land, and trees and flowers grew. Drag them in!
lines.round-2: Day Four: God put lights in the sky. Find the sun, the moon and a star!
lines.round-3: Day Five: God filled the sea with fish and the sky with birds.
lines.round-4: Day Six: God made the animals. Find the lion, the sheep and the elephant!
lines.nope: Not that one yet! That one comes on another day.
lines.win: You did it! And on Day Seven, God rested, because everything He made was very good.
lines.done: Everything God made was very good.

lines.intro: Adam gave every animal its name! Flip the cards over and find two that match.
lines.win: You found every pair! God made every animal, and Adam named them all.
lines.done: God made every animal, and Adam named them all.

lines.intro: Help Noah load the ark! Tap two animals that match, and they’ll walk in together.
lines.win: You did it! Every animal is safe inside the ark.
lines.done: Every animal is safe inside the ark.

lines.intro: God told Abraham to count the stars! Tap each star to make it shine, and let’s count them together.
lines.win: You counted ten stars! And God’s promise to Abraham was even bigger than the sky.
lines.done: God’s promise to Abraham was even bigger than the sky.

lines.intro: Baby Moses is floating down the river! Steer his basket up and down, around the rocks and reeds, and collect six water lilies.
lines.win: You did it! The basket floated right to the princess, and God kept baby Moses safe.
lines.done: God kept baby Moses safe.

lines.intro: Frogs, frogs, everywhere! Tap the frogs to hop them out of Pharaoh’s palace.
lines.win: Fifteen frogs! Pharaoh’s palace is frog-free, for now!
lines.done: Pharaoh’s palace is frog-free!

lines.intro: Moses lifted his staff over the sea. Swipe your finger across the water to part the sea!
lines.parted: The sea is open! Now tap each family to lead them across on dry ground.
lines.win: Everyone made it across! God made a way where there was no way.
lines.done: God made a way where there was no way.

lines.intro: Help David choose five smooth stones from the stream. Tap only the smooth, round ones!
lines.rough: That one’s too pointy! Find a smooth one.
lines.ready: Five smooth stones! Now pull back the sling, and let go to send a stone at Goliath’s helmet.
lines.miss: Try again! Pull back and aim for the helmet.
lines.win: Crash! The giant fell down, and God won the battle!
lines.done: The battle belongs to the Lord!

lines.intro: Jonah is inside the big fish! Drag the fish along the shining lights to bring Jonah to the beach.
lines.win: Splash! The fish spat Jonah out onto dry land. God gave Jonah a second chance!
lines.done: God gave Jonah a second chance.

lines.intro: Let’s put together the picture of the night Jesus was born! Drag each piece to where it belongs.
lines.win: You did it! A baby was born in Bethlehem: Jesus, God’s own Son.
lines.done: Jesus, God’s own Son, was born in Bethlehem.

lines.intro: Jesus told Peter to put his nets down into the deep water. Drag the net to catch the jumping fish!
lines.win: So many fish! The nets were so full, they began to break.
lines.done: Then Jesus said, “Follow Me!”

lines.intro: The lions are roaring! Stroke each lion gently, back and forth, until it curls up and falls asleep.
lines.first: Shh… one lion is fast asleep. Now the next one!
lines.win: All the lions are asleep! God sent His angel and shut the lions’ mouths.
lines.done: God kept Daniel safe all night long.

lines.intro: Jacob made Joseph a coat of many colors! Choose a paint pot, then tap a stripe to color it.
lines.pick: First, choose a color from the paint pots.
lines.win: What a beautiful coat! Joseph twirled around and around.
lines.done: A coat of many colors for Joseph!

lines.intro: Zacchaeus wants to pay everyone back, four times as much! Drag a coin from his purse to each person until they each have four.
lines.full: They have four coins already. Give one to someone else!
lines.win: Everyone is paid back! Jesus gave Zacchaeus a brand-new heart.
lines.done: Jesus came to seek and to save the lost.

lines.intro: Jesus is riding into Jerusalem! Lay a palm branch or a cloak on the glowing spot, and the little donkey will step onto it.
lines.hosanna: Hosanna! Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!
lines.win: Jesus has come to Jerusalem! Hosanna in the highest!
lines.done: Hosanna to the King!

lines.intro: God told Joshua to march around Jericho seven times. Press and hold to march the trumpets around the city!
lines.ready: Seven times around! Now, everybody… SHOUT!
lines.win: The walls came tumbling down! God did just what He promised.
lines.done: The Lord has given you the city!

lines.intro: Everyone ate until they were full! Tap the leftover bread and fish to gather them up. Let’s fill twelve baskets!
lines.win: Twelve baskets of leftovers! A little lunch in Jesus’ hands was more than enough.
lines.done: Jesus is the bread of life.

lines.intro: It’s dark on the hills, and the little lamb is lost! Move the lantern around, listen for a “baa,” and tap the lamb when you find it.
lines.nope: That’s not the lamb! Keep looking.
lines.again: Oh no, that silly lamb wandered off again! Can you find it?
lines.win: Found! The shepherd carried the little lamb home on his shoulders.
lines.done: Rejoice with me, for I have found my lost sheep!

lines.intro: Ruth is gleaning in Boaz’s field! Sweep your finger across the field to gather the barley. Let’s tie seven bundles!
lines.purpose: Look! The workers dropped a handful on purpose, just for Ruth. Catch it!
lines.win: Seven bundles of barley! Ruth and Naomi will have plenty to eat. God took care of them through kind Boaz.
lines.done: God took care of Ruth and Naomi.

lines.intro: On the mountain, God spoke and Moses listened. Watch and listen as the stones light up, then tap them in the same order!
lines.more: Well done! Now a longer one.
lines.win: You listened so well! God’s words are good, and they help us know how to love.
lines.done: Listen to God, and follow His ways.

lines.intro: Jesus’ friends are praying, waiting for the Holy Spirit. Swipe across the room like a mighty rushing wind, and bring a little flame to each of them!
lines.half: Whoosh! Keep blowing like the wind!
lines.win: Wind and fire! They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, just as Jesus promised.
lines.done: You will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes upon you.
